segments.ja210:1.1: Ambho ko nāma yaṃ rukkho, sinnapatto [sīnapatto (sī. pī.)] sakaṇṭako;
segments.ja210:1.3: Yattha ekappahārena, uttamaṅgaṃ vibhijjitaṃ [visāṭikaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), vighāṭitaṃ (sī. niyya)].
segments.ja210:2.1: Acāri vatāyaṃ vitudaṃ vanāni, kaṭṭhaṅgarukkhesu asārakesu;
segments.ja210:2.3: Athāsadā khadiraṃ jātasāraṃ [jātisāraṃ (ka.)], yatthabbhidā garuḷo uttamaṅganti.
segments.ja210:5.1: Daḷhabandhana haṃsavaro ca puna, virūpakkha saviṭṭhaka macchavaro;
segments.ja210:5.3: Sakuruṅga saassaka ambavaro, puna kukkuṭako garuḷena dasāti.
